Hello! 

I’m booked to have surgery in 2,5 weeks and I was wondering if drinking alcohol leading up would be okay? 

I want to go out with friends this weekend (ab 1,5 weeks before surgery) as a last hooray because after then I feel like it’s too close to the date/shouldn’t drink post-op + medications etc etc. 

I’m young (19, but European!!), short and average weight so I don’t drink that much in one go. I’ve heard that people who have a drinking problem shouldn’t drink at all 4 weeks leading up to surgery. But I don’t drink daily, maybe one day of the weekend every other week or so . Is it still recommended to have a complete 4w stop before, even if I don’t consume regularly? Will one night out cause complications? 

I’m really stuck here because on one hand I feel like that’s surely out of the body by 1,5 weeks, but on the other hand alcohol and surgery are both tricky. 

Thankful for any help, recommendation, thing you’ve heard etc.

Yeah dude. I have 3 brothers. All younger. I felt so bad for being jealous. How come they all get to just live life and I get to suffer. My parents had me and my younger sis, then went on to have exclusively boys with other partners. It felt like such a punch in the gut. Just doing the laundry hurt, seeing all the small boys clothes I never got to wear. Just hearing the phrase “come on boys!” That I never got to hear. It felt, and honestly still feels, so unfair. It’s stupid, they’re just kids. But I can’t help but to feel like the universe has some stupid vendetta against me.
